changes.problem: Generated documents repeatedly added title metadata, introductory material, control blocks, acceptance subsections, or open-question sections outside the requested structure.
changes.change: Added an explicit structural allowlist rule and required gaps to be labeled within the nearest requested section unless a separate section is requested or mandatory.
changes.reason: This addresses the recurring weakness in structure and gap handling while preserving the requested GOST scope.

changes.problem: Some outputs added acceptance criteria and verification procedures even when they were not requested, occasionally introducing unsupported interpretations.
changes.change: Made standalone acceptance content conditional on the request and directed testability improvements into requirement wording or numbering otherwise.
changes.reason: This retains verifiability without expanding the deliverable or converting inferred procedures into requirements.

changes.problem: Source meaning was occasionally weakened or altered, including changing cumulative modes into alternatives and turning mandatory requirements into descriptive language.
changes.change: Added explicit preservation rules for modality, conjunctions, alternatives, optionality, and cumulative multi-mode support.
changes.reason: Exact semantic fidelity requires more than copying numeric values and identifiers.

changes.problem: Several runs omitted minor source elements or introduced unsupported explanations while still appearing broadly complete.
changes.change: Added an internal requirement inventory and section-mapping step covering values, modality, responsibilities, interfaces, failures, alternatives, and gaps.
changes.reason: A coverage inventory reduces subtle omissions and unsupported elaboration without imposing extra output sections.

changes.problem: Traceability and verification text sometimes became repetitive and inflated the prescribed structure.
changes.change: Required concise identifiers, numbering, or an internal coverage map and prohibited standalone matrices or repetitive traceability prose unless requested.
changes.reason: This preserves coverage and auditability while avoiding unnecessary document expansion.

changes.problem: Verification criteria sometimes depended on unspecified methods, thresholds, equipment, or conditions.
changes.change: Prohibited invention of verification details and required missing method inputs to remain explicit open questions.
changes.reason: Acceptance criteria should be observable without disguising unresolved engineering decisions as confirmed requirements.

changes.problem: Final checks did not explicitly guard all recurring semantic and structural failure modes.
changes.change: Expanded artifact verification to check requested structure, exact modality and logical relationships, responsibility boundaries, unsupported additions, and acceptance coverage.
changes.reason: A targeted final audit catches the benchmark’s recurring near-miss errors before delivery.
